preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 20
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 20) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) == N for N, A, B in parse_test_cases(stdin))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the strings A and B have equal length N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10³).

preconditions.expression: all(A[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' and B[i] in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for N, A, B in parse_test_cases(stdin) for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Strings A and B contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(is_valid_output(test_case, output) for test_case, output in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), parse_output(stdout)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (impossible) or a valid sequence of operations converting A to B with minimal K operations.

postconditions.expression: all(operations_convert_A_to_B(test_case, output) for test_case, output in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), parse_output(stdout)) if output != -1)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the sequence of operations must successfully convert A to B.

postconditions.expression: all(minimal_operations(test_case, output) for test_case, output in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), parse_output(stdout)) if output != -1)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the number of operations K must be minimal.
